name: @use-brian/app-desktop
description: Use Brian — saved table + board views over your tasks, CRM, and workflow runs.
author: SIDAN Lab

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @use-brian/computer-control build && pnpm --filter @use-brian/browser-control build && tsc -p ../firefox-companion/tsconfig.json && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @use-brian/computer-control build && pnpm --filter @use-brian/browser-control build && tsc -p ../firefox-companion/tsconfig.json && tsc && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && electron dist/bootstrap.js
scripts.build:renderer: pnpm --filter "app-web^..." run build && pnpm --filter app-web build:desktop
scripts.package: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native-computer && pnpm run build:siri && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native-computer:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:native-computer:linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.test:mac-bootstrap: node --test scripts/electron-fuses.test.mjs scripts/build-native-computer.test.mjs scripts/mac-asar-integrity.test.mjs scripts/mac-bootstrap-anchor.test.mjs scripts/mac-visual-fixture-pin.test.mjs scripts/mac-bootstrap-inventory.test.mjs scripts/mac-bootstrap-inventory-verifier.test.mjs scripts/mac-library-constraints.test.mjs scripts/mac-library-constraint-policy.test.mjs scripts/mac-native-signing-policy.test.mjs scripts/mac-release-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/mac-packaged-admission-check.test.mjs
